content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

The architecture behind selling design assets with crypto payments is rooted in providing digital creators with a sovereign and decentralized way to monetize their products. This approach matters because it allows creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce stack, without relying on third-party platforms that charge hefty fees. For instance, Gumroad charges a 10% fee on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, resulting in significant savings for creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by leveraging a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Additionally, NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, allowing for seamless transactions. This setup enables creators to deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.

These creators can now sell their digital products, such as ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and presets, without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. The crypto-based payment system provides an alternative to traditional payment methods, ensuring that creators can reach a global audience and receive payments without significant fees or restrictions.

The Components That Make It Work Together

NOWPayments, on the other hand, facilitates automatic crypto payment verification, making it possible for creators to receive payments in a variety of cryptocurrencies.
